quests.name: Honor Students
quests.text: Bring Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Gryth Thurden
quests.text: Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.

quests.name: Ride to Ironforge
quests.text: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.

quests.name: Return to Brock
quests.text: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Snowbound
quests.text: Deliver a Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane at his house on the northwest coast of the Loch.

quests.name: Thelsamar Blood Sausages
quests.text: Bring 3 pieces of Bear Meat, 3 Boar Intestines, and 3 Spider Ichor to Vidra Hearthstove in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Rat Catching
quests.text: Bring 12 Tunnel Rat Ears to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar.

quests.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
quests.text: Mountaineer Cobbleflint of the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts.

quests.name: The Trogg Threat
quests.text: Bring 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.

quests.name: Fire Sapta
quests.text: Speak to Braldir Ashmantle for another Fire Sapta

quests.name: Stormpike's Order
quests.text: Bring Stormpike's Request to Furen Longbeard in Stormwind.

quests.name: Call of Fire
quests.text: Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.

quests.name: Call of Fire
quests.text: Defeat the Minor Manifestation of Fire, and place the Glowing Ember in the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame.

quests.name: Filthy Paws
quests.text: Go to the Silver Stream Mine and collect 4 loads of Miners' Gear.  Return to Mountaineer Stormpike.

quests.name: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task
quests.text: Speak with Mountaineer Stormpike.

quests.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
quests.text: Mountaineer Gravelgaw in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers and report back to him.

quests.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
quests.text: Mountaineer Wallbang in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.

quests.name: Resupplying the Excavation
quests.text: Speak with Huldar.

quests.name: Excavation Progress Report
quests.text: Bring Ironband's Progress Report to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Report to Ironforge
quests.text: Take Ironband's Progress Report to Prospector Stormpike.

quests.name: Powder to Ironband
quests.text: Speak with Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Protecting the Shipment
quests.text: Ensure Miran and the shipment arrive at the excavation site, then inform Prospector Ironband.

objectives.text: Escort Miran to the excavation site

quests.name: Crocolisk Hunting
quests.text: Get 5 pieces of Crocolisk Meat and 6 Crocolisk Skins for Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge.

quests.name: After the Ambush
quests.text: Speak with Miran.

quests.name: Bingles' Missing Supplies
quests.text: Find and return Bingles' supplies:  Bingles' Wrench, Bingles' Screwdriver, Bingles' Hammer, and Bingles' Blastencapper.

quests.name: A Hunter's Boast
quests.text: Kill 6 Mountain Buzzards and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 15 minutes.

quests.name: Twisting the Knife
quests.text: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.

quests.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
quests.text: Kill the Trogg leader, Grawmug, and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler then report back to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.

quests.name: Banner of the Fallen
quests.text: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.

quests.name: A Hunter's Challenge
quests.text: Kill 5 Elder Mountain Boars and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 12 minutes.

quests.name: Gathering Idols
quests.text: Bring Magmar Fellhew 8 Carved Stone Idols.

quests.name: Ironband's Excavation
quests.text: Speak with Explorer Fellhew.

quests.name: Excavation Tools
quests.text: Return 6 Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.text: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to take the strange smelling powder to Ashlan Stonesmirk, the explosives expert in Dun Modr.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.text: Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and show him the clue that you discovered.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.text: Investigate the area near the eastern ramp of the Dam and bring Chief Engineer Hinderweir a clue that might reveal what the Dark Iron Dwarves are up to.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.text: Ashlan Stonesmirk wants you to return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and inform him of the new discovery.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.text: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to gather Lurker Venom, a Mo'grosh Crystal, and a Crocolisk Tear.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.text: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to swim down to the base of the dam, locate the powder keg and stir in the Disarming Mixture to prevent an explosion.

quests.name: Mercenaries
quests.text: Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar has hired you to kill 4 Mo'grosh Ogres, 4 Mo'grosh Brutes and 4 Mo'grosh Enforcers.

quests.name: Silver of the Waves
quests.text: Return the Monogrammed Silver Hair clip to its owner.

quests.name: Vyrin's Revenge
quests.text: Kill Ol' Sooty then show your handiwork to Daryl the Youngling at the Farstrider Lodge.

quests.name: Vyrin's Revenge
quests.text: Bring Ol' Sooty's head to Vyrin Swiftwind at the Farstrider Lodge.

quests.name: A Dark Threat Looms
quests.text: The Disarming Mixture seemed to take effect. Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir to report the good news.

quests.name: WANTED: Chok'sul
quests.text: Kill Chok'sul and bring his head to Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar.

quests.name: Bailor's Ore Shipment
quests.text: Bring Jordan's Ore Shipment to Bailor Stonehand in Loch Modan.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.text: Find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.text: Drink the Water Sapta and Cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond in Westfall. Return to Norric in Loch Modan when finished.

quests.name: Ingredients for the Forge
quests.text: Bring 10 Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.

quests.name: Eagle's Fist
quests.text: Water spray dampens the air, the view is incredible.

quests.name: Badlands Reagent Run
quests.text: Acquire the reagents Ghak Healtouch needs from the Badlands, then return to him in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Badlands Reagent Run II
quests.text: Use the empty thaumaturgy vessels on scorched guardian dragons found in the Badlands. Once you have them filled, bring them to Ghak Healtouch in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Proof of Deed
quests.text: Take Margol's Gigantic Horn to Curator Thorius in Ironforge.
